task.description: Remediate release-blocking trust, independence, permission, and monitoring defects in commit 47e5e389. AC1 remove all operational Claude and Cursor runtime, prompt, schema, quorum, test, and documentation residue; explicitly allowlist only non-executable historical notes. AC2 Codex is accountable conductor; Antigravity worker and verifier from the same runtime/control/model family must be independent=false; without observed readiness and identity attestation show UNCONFIGURED or UNATTESTED. AC3 verifier evidence is mandatory; trusted validation runner must execute checks itself and reject placeholders, skipped, unmeasured, zero-command, non-zero exit, hash mismatch, or wrong-commit evidence; preserve SUBMITTED != VERIFIED. AC4 enforce prerequisites and allowed write roots before execution; block undeclared network, GPU, environment, and external filesystem access; GPU 0-5 explicit allowlist only and GPU 6-7 always denied. AC5 replace hard-coded Cloudflare ACTIVE/RUNNING/VERIFIED/progress/ledger values with signed ingest, timestamp window, nonce replay protection, monotonic sequence, durable state, and NOT VERIFIED fallback; DEMO must be visibly labelled. AC6 add requirement-to-task-to-evidence-to-independent-verification-to-release traceability and fail-closed release gates. AC7 restore Python, PowerShell, web regression, negative security tests, and CI with zero failed, zero skipped, zero unmeasured. AC8 make README, AGENTS, LICENSE, deployment guide, and UI claims match measured behavior. Submission must include six-section report, machine-readable evidence manifest, exact commands, exit codes, tool versions, source commit, artifact SHA-256, known-answer and negative-test results, rollback/replay, and remaining limitations. The worker must not self-verify.

Acceptance: workspace doctor passes; source, ledger, projection, and deployment commit are attributable; the historical same-family T-001 verification is bound to an append-only verification.restatement and is not counted as trusted; exact replay and rollback commands are retained.
task.title: Phase 1 - Release truth baseline

task.description: Operate Codex task contracts, Antigravity leases, trusted reruns, signed D1 monitoring ingest, publisher restart recovery, and fail-closed status. The worker task remains network-denied; connected deployment and secret provisioning are conductor-only operations after enforcement is verified. Acceptance: before any worker process starts, the runner applies preemptive filesystem confinement and OS-level deny-by-default network isolation; post-run filesystem diffs are only secondary detection. A fresh signed snapshot contains the source commit and task states; stale, corrupt, replayed, or unsigned data is rejected; GPU telemetry accepts only devices 0-5 and always rejects 6-7.
task.title: Phase 2 - Trusted orchestration and live evidence channel

task.description: Create typed Evidence Capsules for every execution: requirement, input, model, code, environment, world, policy, command, output, verifier, replay, and rollback provenance. Acceptance: any missing, skipped, unmeasured, wrong-commit, or unverifiable field makes the release NO_GO.
task.title: Phase 3 - Evidence kernel

task.description: Implement Entity-State-Transition-Constraint schemas, World DSL, belief versus committed state separation, policy verdicts, SSOT commit, human escalation, and rollback. Acceptance: forbidden transitions never commit, deterministic state hashes replay, and all verdicts cite evidence.
task.title: Phase 4 - ESTC world kernel

task.description: Implement the first reference World Pack for regime detection, signals, strategy, portfolio, order proposal, paper execution, reconciliation, and risk limits. Acceptance: point-in-time and look-ahead guards, fees and slippage, exposure limits, known-answer backtests, and deterministic paper-trading reconciliation pass. Live trading is out of scope.
task.title: Phase 5 - Financial investment World Pack

task.description: Build a production-isolated twin with golden scenarios, fault injection, prompt and tool poisoning tests, policy bypass tests, and rollback drills. Acceptance: zero critical forbidden commits and reproducible recovery evidence for every injected failure.
task.title: Phase 6 - Agentic Twin and adversarial validation

task.description: Integrate natural conversation, local tools, file/PDF/image attachments, local RAG, voice, model selection, cancellation, continuation, and bounded history. Acceptance: no hard-coded answer path, no unbounded repetition, no silent truncation, explicit capability truth, and offline tool policy.
task.title: Phase 7 - Local agent workspace

task.description: Integrate the attested local Gemma backbone in the required order: DEQ/CTS, System 1.5 Fast Weight, System 2.5 FP-EWC and C-FIRE, System 3 sparse experts, then System 4 tensor collaboration. Acceptance: each module remains gated until target-hardware memory, convergence, latency, finite-value, and fallback evidence passes on GPUs 0-5 only.
task.title: Phase 8 - Cogni-Core measured integration

task.description: Implement failure collection, bounded patch proposals, isolated regression and security tests, independent verification, canary promotion, and signed rollback. Acceptance: inference and evolution are mutually exclusive and no model or worker can mutate production directly.
task.title: Phase 9 - Governed Self-Harness

task.description: Deliver operator, developer, and executive views of proposal, verdict, execution, commit, evidence, replay, rollback, cost, and domain state. The worker task remains network-denied; connected deployment is a conductor-only operation after the signed evidence channel and isolation controls pass. Acceptance: the UI never displays LIVE or VERIFIED without a fresh, signed, independently verified snapshot and shows exact blocking reasons.
task.title: Phase 10 - CogniBoard evidence operations

task.description: Package the offline Windows appliance, launcher preflight, SBOM, recovery image, operations manual, finance POC evidence pack, and reusable Bio and Defense World Pack contracts. Acceptance: target RTX 4090 runs, 30-run reproduction, restart recovery, rollback, offline network-zero, installer, GPU 0-5 enforcement, and customer replay drills all pass before release.
